routePlaces.title: Buildings, streets and places around the route
routePlaces.source: Sources: Google Places and OpenStreetMap · public map leads
routePlaces.caveat: Map names, addresses and building footprints are discovery leads, not researched stories or mandatory stops. A footprint does not identify the building you mean. Listings do not confirm entry, opening hours, step-free access or a safe path. Coverage is finite and may omit buildings or streets.

researchControls.title: Tour research
researchControls.earlyHint: Normal preparation can continue early after at least 1 stop finishes research. To try immediately, use the experimental tour above.
researchControls.earlyRequested: Early finish requested. Composition and review still need to complete; unfinished stops remain research gaps.
researchControls.readFailed: Some research details could not be refreshed. Any previously loaded data is kept; it may be out of date.
researchControls.actionFailed: The operation or file download could not be confirmed. If an operation is pending, retry that same operation or refresh to check its outcome.
researchControls.uncertain: Outcome not confirmed: {action}. Other changes are blocked; refresh or retry the same operation.
researchControls.conflictingOperation: Another tour request or experimental draft operation is pending. Resolve it before making changes.
researchControls.noGenerations: No research generations have been saved.
researchControls.experimentalGeneration: This is an experimental generation, not eligible for normal acceptance.

confirmations.cancel: Stop the selected research generation? Findings already saved remain available. This does not create a playable draft or stop separate background enrichment.
confirmations.finish-early: Finish research using the stops already completed? The normal composition and review steps will continue and may still cost money. Missing stops remain explicit gaps. This does not make the tour ready immediately or guarantee that the normal release checks will pass.
confirmations.regenerate: Start a new research generation for this tour? This may start paid research and consume your research budget. The current published version is not automatically replaced.
confirmations.accept: Use the selected normally prepared version for this original tour? The backend will apply its normal release checks and replace the tour’s active prepared package. Any cached story for this tour will be cleared. This is not experimental preview acceptance and does not start narration or audio.

researchControls.acceptNotice: A new prepared version can be accepted before starting or after finishing the tour. It must be the latest ready version and pass the normal release checks.
researchControls.archiveNotice: Saved files can include raw, rejected, failed or cancelled research. Being in the archive does not make their contents approved facts.
researchControls.noFiles: No research files have been saved.
researchControls.enrichmentNotice: Separate from tour preparation. Stopping a research generation does not stop background enrichment; no background stop control is available.
researchControls.noEnrichment: No background enrichment status is available.

researchPreview.actionHint: Use saved findings in a separate experimental tour, even if research is incomplete or failed. The original tour and history are kept.
researchPreview.confirmStop: Stop the selected research run and create a separate experimental tour from its saved findings? The original tour, published package and history are preserved. Other research runs and separate background research are not stopped.
researchPreview.confirmSaved: Create a separate experimental tour from the selected research run’s saved findings? The original tour, published package and history are preserved. Other ongoing research is not stopped.
researchPreview.warning: Unverified, incomplete research draft. It uses only findings collected so far, without independent review or additional research. Route feasibility and access have not been verified. Information may be inaccurate or missing; this is not a fully prepared tour.
researchPreview.noAutomaticPlayback: Opening the draft will not start narration or audio.
researchPreview.creating: Stopping active research if needed and saving the draft…
researchPreview.failed: The draft could not be opened or its creation confirmed. Try again to safely retry the same request; no successful tour opening has been confirmed.
researchPreview.confirmOpen: Open the separate experimental draft already saved for this tour? No additional research or new draft will be requested.
researchPreview.openingFailed: The draft was saved, but navigation did not complete. Try again to open that same draft without creating another one.
researchPreview.originalPreserved: The original tour, published package and history are preserved separately.
researchPreview.title: Experimental research draft — unverified
researchPreview.coverage: Stops with saved findings: {available}. Stops missing research: {missing}.
researchPreview.missingStops: Research gaps: {names}. These stops remain on the route, without invented stories to fill the gaps.
researchPreview.routeOnly: No structured findings were saved. This is a route-only draft with explicit research gaps.

preparationProgress.rateLimited: Research stopped because of provider rate limits. Saved sources are kept.
preparationProgress.budgetUnavailable: Research stopped: the tour’s spending limit was reached or its remaining budget could not be verified.
preparationProgress.creditsExhausted: The research provider has no credits. Add credits before retrying.
preparationProgress.refreshFailed: Progress could not be refreshed. Showing the last update; retrying.

preparationProgress.progressEstimateNotice: This percentage reflects recorded stages and research progress, not elapsed time or story availability.
preparationProgress.waitingForActivity: Waiting for a recorded activity update.
preparationProgress.waitingForSnapshot: Waiting for the first research update. Progress and timing are not yet available.
preparationProgress.captionUncertain: The caption request is not confirmed. Factual progress can still update; new caption requests are paused.

captionFallbacks.uncertain: The original caption request is still unconfirmed.
captionFallbacks.budget: A status-writing budget could not be reserved.
captionFallbacks.wording: Generated wording was repeated or could not be safely confirmed.
captionFallbacks.unavailable: A generated caption is unavailable for this update.

preparationProgress.skippedNotice: Processing finished with research gaps. Missing facts or stories are not filled in automatically.
preparationProgress.spendNotice: These are recorded research costs and reservations, not an estimate of remaining time.

remainingNotices.estimate: This is an estimate, not a guaranteed finish time.
remainingNotices.deadline: This limits the current research window, not the time to finish the tour or make stories available.

preparationProgress.completionNotice: Processing has ended. Saved findings and available stories are shown separately.
preparationProgress.savedNotice: Saved findings are retained research, not proof of reviewed facts or available stories. Turns and gathered sources include retries; these counts are not a completion percentage.
